title: Nonconstant product function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a type, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega)\to\mathbb R$. The function $f$ is nonconstant if there are two product inputs on which it takes different values.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on product inputs
